reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives establish a multi-dimensional evaluation space for quarterback performance. The QB Total EPA operator aggregates key performance indicators into a scalar metric, enabling comparative analysis across players and seasons. The two-back formation usage primitive introduces a strategic layer, linking formation choice to expected EPA outcomes under specific defensive alignments. The weighted QB composite integrates disparate metrics into a single score, reflecting a player’s holistic impact. These operators form a dualistic system where individual metrics (e.g., EPA/DB) and composite scores (e.g., QBComposite) interact to inform both GSI probabilistic models and GSE tactical simulations. Failure modes include overfitting due to static weights, misalignment between formation and coverage, and inconsistent data labeling (e.g., duplicate entries in ANY/A leaders).
